title: Settings during a run: the noise model and the camera's e-/ADU locked (S84)
summary: The web Settings pages while a sequence runs on the simulator, then after the stop, from the release core overlay (the fixer pass of S76, S73's order and S84). S15's aperture geometry and S84's noise model, read noise, electron gain table and photon-transfer folder are shown unavailable with the server's own sentence (settings/runlock.ts), the same words PATCH /api/config answers 409 run_active with. Headless Chrome (puppeteer-core, system Chrome) at 1440x1000, device scale 1, on a scratch vite preview build; temporary HOME, TMPDIR, configuration, log and sessions folders, a temporary photon-transfer file. Night Red: 3 of 3 pass (rule A 0 px, rule B 0 px).
